# Workspace Channel Buttons
English | 中文

One 28×28 icon button per @xmanrui/dsh-im
channel that holds an account, placed in the official 「工作区

」 (Workspaces) header row.
Pressing one puts the sidebar into that channel's view: only its conversa

tions are drawn,
and the official list (every other conversation, every group header) waits behind i

t.
Pressing the same entry again drops back to the official list, where every dsh-im
conversation is

e same entry again drops back to the official list, where every dsh-im
conversation is hidden again.

This is the single feature extracted from `eva-inspired-theme`: the buttons and nothing
else. No ski

n, no theme replacement, no dependency on the theme's CSS, locale namespace
or build pipeline.
## Install

## Migrating from the theme edition
`eva-inspired-theme` 1.2.0 no longer contains these buttons. Do **not** install both:

- The theme edition uses the `data-eva-im-*` contract and the `eva-im-filter` locale
namespace; this

package uses `data-dsh-im-*` and `dsh-im-workspace-buttons`. Installed
together they draw two sets

of buttons on the same row, and neither stylesheet covers
the other's.
- Upgrading to `eva-inspired-

theme@1.2.0` and installing this package is a drop-in swap:
interaction, icons, order and the visibi
lity rule are identical.
## Behaviour

| Plugin id | `dsh-im-workspace-buttons` (also the client module id and the locale namespace) |
| Wh
ere | The header row carrying the official `sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow` marker, left of the se

arch slot, in the plugin's own channel order |
| Visibility | An entry appears only when the channel
**has an account**: `connection.status` returns a non-empty `botId` in `bots[]`, or the older `conf
igured: true`. An inconclusive probe (RPC not ready, request failed) draws nothing on the first pass

and keeps the previous verdict after that |
| Click | Puts the sidebar into that channel's view: it
s conversation rows (recognised by `data-dsh-im-session-channel` or by the row's title belonging to
the channel) stay, and **every other row — other channels, official conversations, group headers, sh

ow-more controls — is hidden**. A second click drops back to the official list |
| Collapsed groups
| Unfolded, paged and scrolled to the channel's first conversation only on click, capped at `CLICK_L
IMIT = 200` steps. The controls are hidden in the view but still clickable, so the rows are drawn be

fore they are hidden |
| dsh-im hidden by default | No dsh-im conversation shows in any of the three
views — 工作区, 工作区树, single list — until its entry is pressed. Every dsh-im row carries `data-eva-im-
tag='off'`; only the lit channel's own rows turn `'on'`. A row that is not a dsh-im conversation is
never tagged and is never hidden by the official list; in a lit view it is `'off'` like everything e

lse |
| Group ownership | A conversation counts as living in exactly one group, decided by `home()`:
the workspace record whose `sessionIds` names it owns it, and everything else is Ungrouped (the emp
ty `workspace:` suffix). That is the host's own rule (`groupByWorkspace`); `cwd` takes no part in it

|
| Ungrouped bucket | Ungrouped has no header to press — only its own show-more control, keyed `ov

erflow:` with nothing after the colon. The plugin clicks that control and never a header for it |
[该

:` with nothing after the colon. The plugin clicks that control and never a header for it |

## Style contract

The runtime injects its own `<style data-dsh-im-workspace-buttons-sheet>`; every colour
comes from a

ts its own `<style data-dsh-im-workspace-buttons-sheet>`; every colour
comes from a `--dsw-*` token:
| Selector | Effect |
| `[data-eva-im-button]` | 28×28, no border, no background, `--dsw-radius-sm` corners, `--dsw-alias-

label-secondary` foreground |
| `[data-eva-im-button]:hover` | Foreground turns `--dsw-alias-label-p

rimary` |
| `[data-eva-im-state='on']` | The lit entry turns `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` |
| `[data-
eva-im-tag='off']` | Hides that one row — the only hiding rule in the sheet. It is written on dsh-im
rows while no entry is lit, and on every row that does not belong to the lit channel |

The `data-eva-im-*` prefix is kept verbatim from the extraction; renaming it would break
style compa

tibility with `eva-inspired-theme`. The rule is a plain attribute test, so an
"off" state must be wr

itten explicitly: a row with no tag is a row the host draws as-is.
The tag lives on its own attribut

e rather than on `data-eva-im-row`, which is in this
effect's MutationObserver filter — a per-row ta

g there would re-trigger every pass. The
pump hides rows *after* it has clicked them, which is why t

he sheet never hides a control
the runtime still has to click.
## Dependencies
| Dependency | Kind |
| `@xmanrui/dsh-im` | **Required at runtime.** The channel table and the status probe both read its

`connection.status`; without it no button appears |
| Host client services `sessions` / `workspaces`

/ `locale` / `connection` | Taken through `ctx.get` only, never imported |
| `eva-inspired-theme` |
**Not needed.** Styles, locale namespace and build are all self-contained |

ent.js` as a classic script, so the file cannot contain a module graph.
